_doc: The Greenhouse Dome: GrassLand v2's bright flower meadow for the floor, its darker meadow and cliff face (RPGW_GrassLand_v2.01: the solid blocks on the right of MainLev2.0.png are seamless fills), Set 1's bright grass (turf, the old floor), darker grass blob and tall grass for the beds (RPGFW_Set1_v1.0), Decorative Props' wooden fence (fencelines: posts and rails composed into joined lines), pots, barrels and crates (RPGW_DecorativeProps_v1.0); the hand dressing's cuts (assets/arenas/greenhouse_dressing.tscn): lantern posts, sacks, baskets, ivy, flagstones, a tree crown, the path / earth / meadow_deep / grass_sun terrains and the appended scatter kinds. Keys: tools/cut_tiles.py. Paths are relative to the packs dir.

meadow_bright._doc: GrassLand's bright flower meadow (the block at x 1728-2047, y 704-1023), the Greenhouse floor

path._doc: dressing: trodden earth paths between the beds and from the doors (the dressing scene's Paths layer): Set 1's tan dirt band as keeps.json's path, a touch warmer for the dome

earth._doc: dressing: the same band darkened as damp, watered earth (the Earth layer: at the fence feet and round the beds' corners)

meadow_deep._doc: dressing: GrassLand's darker yellow-flowered meadow laid in Set 1's ragged grass blob (as keeps.json's meadow), lifted a step so it reads as shade, not a hole: shady patches

grass_sun._doc: dressing: the floor's own bright meadow lifted toward gold in ragged patches: sun through the glass

overlay._doc: the pits' far wall: a seamless cliff face from the matching pack; the lip and the cracks: the floor's own fill (tools/cut_tiles.py cut_overlay)

flowers._doc: Decorative Props' tiny single flowers (vegA4, frame 0 of the pink and mauve rows), still, for the meadow

flowers_tall._doc: Decorative Props' small single flowers on a stalk (vegA2, frame 0 of the pink and yellow rows)

tufts._doc: Set 1 low grass sprigs, the olive and the bright green ones

pebbles._doc: Set 1 loose single pebbles and chips

moss._doc: dressing (new kinds go at the end: the dressing scene paints slots by place): Set 1 pads as moss at the fence feet and the beds' corners

clover._doc: vegA1's first frame (pink, green): flower clumps

stones._doc: flat stepping stones (g_terrain4 rubble, greyed), across the paths

flowers_gold._doc: Set 1's small flowers as they come: four yellow, four blue clumps

leaves._doc: a few fallen leaves under the crowns: round chunks of the oak's canopy, turned yellow-green

shadows._doc: contact shadows under the dressing's props (tools/seed_dressing.gd picks the size nearest a prop's width)

sack_seed_a._doc: dressing (the Greenhouse fences): Windmill's open grain sacks as seed sacks (Mill_decoratives is a props sheet: the one exception to one buildings pack a map, as on Twin Keeps)

sheaf._doc: a wheat sheaf leant on a fence

basket_carrot._doc: Houses smallobj produce baskets (row y96) and empty baskets and a bucket (row y64): the harvest

bucket._doc: a wooden bucket for the watering

pot_clay._doc: propsA fat pot, the orange-clay band

pot_olive._doc: propsA ring pot, the olive band

barrel_open._doc: an open barrel: the rain butt

ivy._doc: a leafy clump of the Wetland canopy (the beds' own hedge), masked round: vines over the fence rails

slab_c._doc: flat: a small flagstone from GrassLand's stone-slab bridge, greyed: the pads at the doors

cobble_disc._doc: flat: Set 1's round cobble patch (ragged rim)

shrub_gold._doc: GrassLand decorative.png tiny bush, yellow-green (the band's bushes stand on the box's bottom row)

shrub_red._doc: the same tiny bush in autumn red

herb_pink._doc: Houses smallobj row y 96: potted flowers and herbs, one per 32 px cell, hard alpha, no baked shadow; feet on each pot's last row

lantern._doc: dressing: DecorativeProps lantern post (row pitch 128, 96 px of art) at the fence ends; a lamp on its flame in the arena's lights

tree_canopy._doc: dressing: GrassLand's big olive tree's crown with no bark showing (as keeps.json's tree_a_canopy), over the corner beds; ArenaView fades it over our own fighters

flower_pink._doc: DecorativeProps vegA1 (clumps of three) pink, colour row 0; 32 px frames, the first four of its 10-frame loop (row 0); roots on the frame's last row

flower_yellow._doc: vegA1 yellow, colour row 2 (32 px row 8)

spike_pink._doc: DecorativeProps vegC1 (flower spikes) pink, colour row 1 (32 px row 4); roots at y 26

spike_orange._doc: vegC1 orange, colour row 0; roots at y 27

green._doc: a hedge from the green Wetland tree's canopy: four leaf boxes (the sunny lower-right clump, the shaded lower-left one, the crown and the right lobe; the first frame's boxes, the sheet's 5 sway frames give the bed its sway), each cut twice as a round clump with its own leafy outline; a bed scatters them overlapping (tools/build_tiles.gd _blob_bed), so it reads as one hedge with no column seams or square edge

wood._doc: Decorative Props' wooden fence as continuous lines: a lone post (row 5), a stretch of the long top rail (row 1) and the edge-on rail of the left-hand vertical run (column 0); cut_tiles.py composes every end, run, corner and junction from them
